title: CSV rerun planned output collision guard
summary: Add backend CSV rerun planned-output collision detection so duplicate destination rows are either disabled during audit export or blocked before rerun launch.
reason: Audit rerun exports could include multiple source rows that normalize to the same rerun workspace output path, causing the long-running PowerShell import to fail those rows late.
behavior_before: Rerun CSV export preserved all enabled rows, and preview/start only blocked duplicate source_path values. Rows with different sources but the same computed planned output reached the PowerShell rerun planner and failed during import.
behavior_after: Rerun CSV export keeps duplicate rows for evidence but disables later rows sharing the same planned-output key. Preview/start blocks manually supplied CSVs that still contain enabled duplicate planned-output rows before spawning the rerun process.
manual_validation: py_compile rerun CSV Python files - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the changes to rerun_csv.py, rerun_export.py, rerun_preview.py, the three targeted tests, their generated summaries, and this change packet. Existing media, active rerun manifests, and source files are not modified by this change.
notes:
